corrections: LOAD-BEARING NUMBER STALE — the OBBBA cut is BIGGER than the bear models: the bear (and the Q2-2025 call) used a $360-400M annual net-benefit reduction by 2032. The company's own latest primary filings (FY2025 10-K filed 2026-02-25 and Q1 2026 10-Q filed 2026-05-07) raised that estimate to approximately $432-480M by 2032, phased pro-rata from the 2028 state fiscal years. The bear's headline impairment is ~20% understated against the company's own current number.

EXPOSED STREAM UNDERSTATED: the '~$1.2B annual net benefit' is stale. Per the 10-K table, the 2025 actual aggregate net benefit from all supplemental Medicaid programs was $1.339B ($1.361B as restated in the 10-Q narrative), with $1.362B PROJECTED for 2026 — the contested stream is still growing into the cliff. Sharpest verified fact the bear missed: Q1 2026 DPP net benefit was $369M vs $236M in Q1 2025 (+$133M pre-tax YoY) while total pre-tax income rose only ~$40M — the ENTIRE Q1 2026 earnings beat (adj EPS $5.62 vs $4.84) and more came from the contested stream; ex-DPP core earnings declined year over year. The earnings-quality point (TTM FCF $894M vs TTM net income ~$1.53B — both verified via FMP TTM statements) is confirmed and stronger than written.

SOP ARITHMETIC FIXES (all adverse): (1) share count — the bear's ~$162 break divides by ~60.5M shares; Q1 2026 weighted diluted shares were 61.668M (8-K/10-Q), (2) net debt — $5.007B at 3/31/2026 verifies, but is stale versus the pending debt-financed Talkspace acquisition (announced 2026-03-09, $5.25/sh, ~$835M, funded via revolver + a new $400M delayed-draw term loan A under the April 2026 credit amendment, closing Q3 2026) -> pro forma net debt ~$5.84B, (3) re-basing the strip to the company's own $432-480M at the bear's 6x. Corrected, the bear's conservative parts value falls from ~$162 to roughly $130-140/share — BELOW the current price ($150.58, 2026-07-01), not 11% below $145. The stated '6:1 reward-to-risk' and the wrong-signed 'downside to the bear break' do not survive: realistic downside to the corrected break is ~7-13%, with a materially lower tail if CMS-2449-P finalizes as proposed.

REGULATORY TAIL BEYOND THE STATUTE (new since the debate): CMS proposed rule CMS-2449-P (fact sheet 2026-05-20, Federal Register 2026-05-22) goes beyond OBBBA — Medicare-based caps extended to essentially all services for new SDPs, grandfathered SDPs phased down 10 percentage points per year on TOTAL DOLLAR AMOUNTS from rating periods on/after 1/1/2028, uniform-rate-increase SDPs prohibited; CMS scores ~$775B/decade vs CBO's ~$149B for the statute. Still PROPOSED (comments closed ~2026-07-21; hospital groups threaten legal challenge), but it makes the company's $432-480M a floor-ish scenario rather than a bound. The 52-week low ($140.08) printed in early June 2026, after the rule.

BEAR'S NEAR-TERM TIMING NOW ACTUAL: enhanced ACA premium tax credits expired 12/31/2025; the Senate extension failed, the House's 3-year extension (H.R.1834, passed 2026-01-08) is stalled, and the 10-Q states 'as of early May 2026, no legislation extending the EPTCs has been enacted.' Q1 2026 acute same-facility adjusted admissions were 0.0% and behavioral +1.2% (still below the 2.5-3% aspiration) — both verified in the 8-K. Counterweights the bear must absorb: the quarter still beat, FY2026 guidance is ~+8.5% adjusted EPS, and $1.298B buyback authorization remains (though Q1 repurchases slowed to $127.3M at ~$189 avg, above the current price).

HIDDEN DISQUALIFIER CHECK — behavioral quality/regulatory tail risk is LIVE, not historical: Laurel Ridge Treatment Center (330-bed, San Antonio, the largest psychiatric hospital in Texas) was TERMINATED from Medicare AND Medicaid effective 4/30/2026 after patient deaths; TRO denied; 648 of 659 staff laid off effective 6/26/2026; recertification uncertain; the facility earned ~$23M pre-tax in 2025 and now generates operating losses (10-Q). Cumberland litigation: March 2026 new trial granted (juror misconduct) with only an $18M reserve and ~40 additional plaintiffs pending; Pinnacle/Reno Sept-2025 $500M punitive verdict expected statutorily reduced to ~$14M. None individually kills a ~$14.4B EV, but the pattern (Pavilion settled 2025, Cumberland, Laurel Ridge) is a recurring uninsured tail on the behavioral segment the bull side treats as the 'hedge.' Insider check verified via Form 4 aggregates: ZERO open-market purchases 2024-Q2 2026; nobody is buying the low.

SECTOR-BETA CLAIM PARTLY CORRECTED: HCA (-29% off 52wk high) and THC (-23%) did de-rate together, but ACHC sits at its 52-week high and UHS (-39%) is the WORST of the acute cohort — rationally so, since its DPP net benefit (~$1.36B) is roughly two-thirds of pre-tax income, the highest relative exposure in the group.
